items.q: Why did games and 综艺 stop destressing him?
items.a: Both still run through **other humans**. Lock a hero and the teammate keyboard never stops. Open 综艺 and a danmaku grades the laugh. The hobby is fine. The social layer is a second job.

items.q: What is stricter than failing 12 classes?
items.a: Ranked chat. Senior year he failed **12** and the principal never said 亲妈爆炸. Bronze-2 teammates treat draft like RNG 青训 and plan his build harder than he planned a life.

items.q: What does 好笑吗 actually judge?
items.a: **His mouth**, not the comic. A sea of 哈哈, then one line, and the grin closes. Same shape as '长得像有头发的包贝尔': the room scores the viewer.

items.q: What is the only operator move in the script?
items.a: **Never open mic. Never open danmaku.** He will not police speech. He leaves the channel. No 牛逼 systemic fix — any destress that still deals with humans is already leaky. Caption closer 银帕除外 is unverified.

sections.title: Earned fun can still feel bad

items.q: How is this different from Urban's dark playground?
items.a: Urban: **unearned** leisure soaked in guilt. 死盖: he already worked; the queue and the barrage still ruin the hour. [[proper-leisure]] wants people in the rest. He wants them muted.

items.q: What leftover exam skill shows up in ranked?
items.a: Build-order clarity he never used on a life. Pair with [[exam-only-life-script]]: childhood was only the paper; adulthood still gets graded in chat.
